test_distinct_on_single_column: test DISTINCT ON with a single column keeps the first row per distinct value
test_distinct_on_multiple_columns: test DISTINCT ON with multiple columns keeps the first row per distinct combination
test_distinct_on_after_join: test DISTINCT ON applied after a JOIN operation between two dataframes
test_distinct_on_with_ordering: test DISTINCT ON where ORDER BY determines which row is kept per group
test_distinct_on_with_distinct_aggregati: test DISTINCT ON with distinct count aggregation used within a JOIN query
